Vendored snapshot of the DMD_STM32 SPWM/RP driver used by this firmware.

Upstream: https://github.com/board707/DMD_STM32 (GPL-3.0)
Jan's library fork (PRs back to upstream): https://github.com/jan1503/dmd_stm32

This folder is the compile-time Arduino `--library` path. It is not a complete
mirror of DMD_STM32 (no STM32 examples, no GFX font packs). Driver changes that
are generally useful should still go through the fork.
